mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.iam_account account JOIN public.iam_tenant tenant ON tenant.id = account.tenant_id AND tenant.is_deleted = false JOIN public.iam_organization organization ON organization.id = account.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND organization.is_deleted = false WHERE account.id = #{accountId} AND account.is_deleted = false LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM public.iam_tenant tenant JOIN public.iam_org_owner owner ON owner.tenant_id = tenant.id AND owner.organization_id = tenant.root_organization_id AND owner.is_deleted = false JOIN public.iam_account account ON account.id = owner.account_id AND account.tenant_id = tenant.id AND account.is_deleted = false JOIN public.iam_organization organization ON organization.id = account.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND organization.is_deleted = false WHERE tenant.id = #{tenantId} AND tenant.is_deleted = false LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE public.iam_account SET status = 'ACTIVE', profile_version = profile_version + 1, updated_by = id, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{accountId} AND status = 'PENDING_ACTIVATION' AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE public.iam_account SET status = 'PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED', authz_version = authz_version + 1, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{accountId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED') AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE public.iam_account SET status = 'ACTIVE', profile_version = profile_version + 1, authz_version = authz_version + 1, updated_by = id, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{accountId} AND status = 'PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED' AND is_deleted = false

SELECT tenant.id AS tenant_id, account.username, account.status AS account_status FROM public.iam_tenant tenant JOIN public.iam_org_owner owner ON owner.tenant_id = tenant.id AND owner.organization_id = tenant.root_organization_id AND owner.is_deleted = false JOIN public.iam_account account ON account.id = owner.account_id AND account.tenant_id = tenant.id AND account.is_deleted = false WHERE tenant.is_deleted = false AND tenant.id IN
#{tenantId}

SELECT account.id AS account_id, account.tenant_id, account.organization_id, account.username, account.display_name, account.status AS account_status, tenant.status AS tenant_status, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.iam_organization_closure effective_path JOIN public.iam_organization disabled_ancestor ON disabled_ancestor.tenant_id = effective_path.tenant_id AND disabled_ancestor.id = effective_path.ancestor_id AND disabled_ancestor.is_deleted = false WHERE effective_path.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND effective_path.descendant_id = account.organization_id AND effective_path.is_deleted = false AND disabled_ancestor.own_status = 'DISABLED' ) THEN 'DISABLED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS organization_status, account.authz_version, policy.concurrent_login_enabled, policy.max_devices, policy.remember_me_enabled, policy.idle_seconds, policy.absolute_seconds, policy.remember_idle_seconds, policy.remember_absolute_seconds FROM public.iam_account account JOIN public.iam_tenant tenant ON tenant.id = account.tenant_id AND tenant.is_deleted = false JOIN public.iam_organization organization ON organization.id = account.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND organization.is_deleted = false JOIN public.iam_tenant_security_policy policy ON policy.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND policy.is_deleted = false WHERE account.normalized_username = #{normalizedUsername} AND account.is_deleted = false AND (account.validity_mode = 'LONG_TERM' OR (account.effective_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND account.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) LIMIT 1

SELECT account.id AS account_id, account.tenant_id, tenant.name AS tenant_name, account.organization_id, organization.name AS organization_name, tenant.root_organization_id, account.username, account.display_name, account.status AS account_status, tenant.status AS tenant_status, organization.own_status AS organization_status, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.iam_org_owner current_owner WHERE current_owner.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND current_owner.organization_id = account.organization_id AND current_owner.account_id = account.id AND current_owner.is_deleted = false ) AS organization_owner, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.iam_org_owner owner WHERE owner.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND owner.organization_id = tenant.root_organization_id AND owner.account_id = account.id AND owner.is_deleted = false ) AS root_owner FROM public.iam_account account JOIN public.iam_tenant tenant ON tenant.id = account.tenant_id AND tenant.is_deleted = false JOIN public.iam_organization organization ON organization.id = account.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND organization.is_deleted = false WHERE account.id = #{accountId} AND account.is_deleted = false LIMIT 1
